scope: Scenario B telemetry instrumentation used by the experiment overlays

items.notes: Application RPC duration/outcome is measured by the shared outer handler wrapper; OTel records the supplied observation. Payment application errors use the shared explicit event adapter.
RPC and Redis operation durations/outcomes are computed once in the application interceptor/operation and supplied to the conventional and OTel metric/span adapters.

checkoutservice gRPC server/client interceptors now compute shared RPC duration/outcome and feed the OTel metric adapter; the client emits one shared downstream failure event. Other Go services still use separate conventional interceptors and OTel framework metrics without a shared completion object.
The current code paths use separate conventional and OTel wrappers; a shared completion observation is not yet wired.
The Java agent and conventional interceptor currently observe the RPC independently; a shared completion observation is not yet wired.

readiness: PARTIAL: paymentservice, currencyservice, checkoutservice, and cartservice fault-relevant paths are wired to shared observations. Other Go services, Python services, and Java adservice still need shared completion adapters before claiming system-wide adoption.
